accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: The company's chart of accounts and the accounts used by automatic entries.
accounts.emptyDescription: The chart is installed automatically when the company is created.
accounts.mappingsDescription: Invoices and payments refer to a logical key; this is where it is linked to an account of the chart. Switching to another accounting framework simply means changing these links.

balance.title: Trial balance
balance.description: Debit/credit totals per account. Both columns must add up to the same total.
balance.emptyDescription: No account has movements in the selected period.

entries.title: General journal
entries.description: All entries, generated automatically or recorded manually.
entries.empty: No entries in this period. Invoices and payments generate them automatically.

dialog.title: Record an entry
dialog.description: The entry must be balanced: total debits must equal total credits.

ledger.title: General ledger
ledger.description: Movements by account. Select an account to follow its running balance.
ledger.emptyDescription: No entries match the selected criteria.
